title: Kwamitin Wasannin Paralympic na Duniya
text:
Kwamitin Paralympic na Duniya (IPC; Jamusanci: Internationales Paralympisches Komitee) kungiya ce ta kasa da kasa ba ta riba ba kuma kungiya ce mai kula da duniya don Motsi na Paralympic .
Manufar IPC ita ce ta jagoranci Movement na Paralympic, kula da isar da Wasannin Paralympic da tallafawa kungiyoyin mambobi 200 da yawa don ba da damar 'yan wasa na Para su cimma kyakkyawan wasanni. An kafa shi a ranar 22 ga Satumba 1989 a Düsseldorf, sannan wani ɓangare na Jamus ta Yamma, hangen nesa shine "yi duniya mai hada kai ta hanyar wasanni na Para". Bugu da ƙari, IPC tana da niyyar amfani da wasanni na Para a matsayin mai haɓaka don canza halayen, dokoki, da ƙirƙirar damar da ta fi girma ga mutane biliyan 1.3 da ke da nakasa a duniya.
IPC tana da kundin tsarin mulki da tsari na dimokuradiyya kuma ta ƙunshi wakilai daga Kwamitocin Paralympic na kasa 187 (NPCs),  18 Ƙungiyoyin Kasa da Kasa, ƙungiyoyin Wasanni na Duniya guda uku don nakasassu (IOSDs)  da ƙungiyoyin yanki guda biyar. Hedikwatar IPC tana cikin Bonn, Jamus.
== Bayani na gaba ɗaya ==
Dangane da samun damar shirya Wasannin Paralympic yadda ya kamata da kuma ba da murya ɗaya ga ƙungiyar Paralympic, ƙungiyoyin wasanni na duniya guda huɗu don nakasassu sun kafa Kwamitin Gudanarwa na Duniya na Ƙungiyoyin Wasanni na Duniya don nakasasshen (ICC) a cikin 1982. title: Haƙƙoƙin ɗan'adam
text:
Haƙƙoƙin ɗan adam ƙa'idodi ne na ɗabi'a ko ƙa'idodi waɗanda ke kafa ƙa'idodin ɗabi'ar ɗan adam kuma galibi ana kiyaye su ta hanyar dokokin ƙasa da na ƙasa da na duniya.  Ana ɗaukar waɗannan haƙƙoƙi a matsayin na asali kuma ba za a iya kwace su ba, ma'ana sun kasance na kowane mutum ne kawai saboda kasancewarsa ɗan adam . Sun ƙunshi fannoni daban-daban na haƙƙoƙin farar hula, siyasa, tattalin arziki, zamantakewa, da al'adu, kamar ' yancin rayuwa, 'yancin faɗar albarkacin baki, kariya daga bauta, da kuma 'yancin ilimi .
Duk da cewa ra'ayoyin da suka shafi haƙƙin ɗan adam sun riga zamanin zamani, ra'ayin zamani na haƙƙin ɗan adam ya sami karbuwa sosai bayan Yaƙin Duniya na Biyu, musamman a martanin kisan kiyashin da aka yi wa Yahudawa, wanda ya haifar da amincewa da Sanarwar Haƙƙin Ɗan Adam ta Duniya (UDHR) da Babban Taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ya yi a shekarar 1948. , Wannan takarda ta bayyana cikakken tsarin haƙƙoƙin da ake ƙarfafa ƙasashe su karewa, inda ta kafa mizani na duniya game da mutuncin ɗan adam, 'yanci, da adalci. title: Jim Miller (mai laifi)
text:
James Brown Miller 25  ga watan Oktoba a shekara ta 1861 zuwa ga watan Afrilu 19, 1909), wanda aka fi sani da Killin' Jim Killer Miller da Deacon Jim ɗan Amurka ne kuma mai riƙe da bindiga na Tsohon Yammacin ƙasar Amurka, ya ce ya kashe mutane 12 yayin yaƙe-yaƙe. Wasu sun kira Miller da sunan Deacon Jim saboda yana halartar Cocin Methodist a kai a kai, kuma bai taba sigari ko sha ba. an kashe shi a Ada, Oklahoma, a cikin shekara ta 1909 tare da wasu mazauna uku, ta hanyar taron mazauna da suka yi fushi cewa ya kashe tsohon mataimakin Marshal na ƙasar Amurka.
== Rayuwa ta farko ==
An haifi Miller a Van Buren, Arkansas, amma iyayensa sun yi ƙaura zuwa Franklin, Texas lokacin da yake ɗan shekara ɗaya, kuma ya girma a can. Mahaifinsa Jacob Miller, wanda aka haifa a Pennsylvania a cikin 1801, masanin dutse ne, kuma ya taimaka wajen gina ginin farko a Austin. An haifi mahaifiyar Miller Cynthia Basham . Bayan 'yan shekaru bayan tafiyar, mahaifin Miller ya mutu, don haka mahaifiyarsa ta tafi da iyalin zuwa Evant, Texas don zama tare da iyayenta. title: 'Yan asalin ƙasar
text:
Indigenismo (es ) akidar siyasa ce a ƙasashe da dama na Latin Amurka wadda ke jaddada alaƙar da ke tsakanin ƙasar ƙasar da ƙasashen 'Yan Asalin da kuma mutanen 'Yan Asalin .  A wasu amfani na zamani, yana nufin neman ƙarin haɗin kai tsakanin 'yan asalin ƙasar Latin Amurka da jama'arsu, ko ta hanyar gyare-gyare a faɗin ƙasa ko kuma haɗin gwiwa a duk faɗin yanki.  Wannan nau'in ' indigenismo yana neman kare bambancin al'adu da harshe na 'yan asalin ƙasar, tabbatar da haƙƙin 'yan asalin ƙasar, da kuma neman amincewa da kuma a wasu lokuta diyya ga kurakuran da suka gabata na ƙasashen mulkin mallaka da na jamhuriya.  Wasu fitattun mutane na tarihi kamar José Martí an sanya su a matsayin 'yan asalin ƙasar da kuma 'yan Hispanista. 
== Asalin ƙasar Cuba ==
Masanin shari'a Larry Catá Backer ya rubuta cewa 'Yan asalin ƙasar Cuba "yan asalin ƙasar ne ba tare da 'yan Indiya ba... inda ake girmama tunawa da 'yan asalin ƙasar", amma inda 'yan asalin ƙasar suka ɓace zuwa "taro ɗaya amma gauraye". A cikin irin wannan "Kuba ba tare da 'Yan Indiya ba", gwamnatin Cuba tana goyon bayan haƙƙin 'yan asalin ƙasar a ko'ina hanya ce ta tabbatar da haƙƙin Cuba a matsayin ƙasa ba tare da Cuba ta magance "batun 'yan Indiyawanta ba". Backer ya rubuta cewa Fidel Castro da José Martí manyan 'yan siyasa ne da suka tallata 'yan asalin ƙasar Cuba.

title: Makarantar Sakandare ta Alexander Sinton
text:
Makarantar Sakandare ta Alexander Sinton, wacce aka fi sani da Makarantar Sakandaren Alexander Sinton. Makarantar Turanci ce a Athlone, wani yanki na Cape Town, Afirka ta Kudu . Makarantar tana cikin Cape Flats, wani yanki da aka sanya shi a matsayin wanda ba fari ba a karkashin Dokar Yankin Ƙungiya a lokacin wariyar launin fata. Makarantar ta shiga cikin tashin hankali na dalibai na adawa da wariyar launin fata na shekarun 1970 da 1980. Ma'aikata da dalibai a makarantar sun zama manyan labarai lokacin da suka toshe 'yan sanda a cikin makarantarsu a watan Satumbar 1985.  A watan da ya biyo baya, jami'an 'yan sanda ne suka kashe matasa uku a kusa da makarantar wadanda suka bude wuta a kan masu zanga-zangar a cikin lamarin Trojan Horse .  Ita ce makarantar farko da Nelson Mandela ya ziyarta bayan an sake shi daga kurkuku. Ya zuwa shekara ta 2014, makarantar tana da dalibai 1,100, rabin yara maza da rabin mata. Makarantar tana daukar malamai 40 da ma'aikatan da ba malamai ba shida.
== Wanda ya kafa shi ==
An sanya wa makarantar suna ne saboda mai ba da gudummawa Alexander Sinton, wanda ya ba da kuɗi don kafa makarantar a shekara ta 1951. 
== Tashin hankali na 1976 ==
A lokacin Tashin hankali na matasa na 1976 suna nuna rashin amincewa da tilasta harshen Afrikaans a matsayin hanyar koyarwa a makarantu, ɗalibai a makarantar da Makarantar Sakandare ta Belgravia da ke kusa da Athlone

title: All Progressives Congress
text:
Jam'iyyar APC jam'iyyar siyasa ce mai mulki a Najeriya, wadda aka kafata a ranar 6 ga watan Fabrairu na shekarar 2013, gabannin zuwan zaɓen shekarar 2015.   Ɗan takarar APC a matakin shugaban kasa shine Muhammadu Buhari ya kuma lashe zaɓen shugaban ƙasar da kusan kuri'u miliyan 2.6.   Shugaban ƙkasa Goodluck Jonathan yayi nasara a ranar 31 ga watan Maris.   Wannan shi ne karo na farko a tarihin siyasa cewa jam'iyyun siyasa na adawa sun kayar da wata jam'iyya mai mulki a babban zaɓe, kuma ɗaya daga cikin wutar lantarki ta sauya zaman lafiya daga wata jam'iyyar siyasa zuwa wata.   Bugu da kari, APC ta lashe rinjaye mafi yawa a majalisar dattijai da majalisar wakilai a zaben shekarar 2015, sannan kuma sun ansa mulkin kasar a hannun jam'iyya mai mulki.
Me ya bambanta haɗakar APC da ta ADC?
A ranar Laraba wasu gaggan ƴan hamayya a Najeriya suka sanar da dunƙulewarsu a jam'iyyar ADC domin yin haɗaka a ƙalubalanci ƙudirin shugaba Bola Tinubu na tazarce a 2027.
Ƴan siyasar, ƙarƙashin jagorancin sanata David Mark, sun haɗa da tsohon mataimakin shugaban Najeriya, Atiku Abubakar da tsohon ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa na jam'iyyar Labour, Peter Obi da Rotimi Amaechi da Rauf Argebesola da Malam Nasiru El- Rufai da dai sauran jiga-jigan ƴan siyasa daga kudu da arewacin ƙasar. title: Abuja
text:
Bayan tsohuwar babban birnin Legas a ranar (12) ,ga watan disambar. (December. shekara ta alif dubu ɗaya da ɗari-tara da cassa'in da ɗaya   (1991). 
Birnin dai ya koma na tarayya ne tun a lokacin mulkin Gen. Ibrahim Babangida a shekara ta alif dubu ɗaya da ɗari tara da cassa'in da ɗaya (1991) wanda kafin lokacin birnin tarayyar ya kasance a birnin Legas dake kudu maso yammacin Najeriya. Birnin Abuja ya kasance birni ne gagara misali saboda birnin ya ƙunshi abubuwa da dama wanda ido ne kaɗai zai iya tabbatar da hakan. Inda yake ɗauke da manyan ma'aikatu, makarantu, filayen jiragen sama, dmanyain wasa babba, da dai sauran manya-manyan ma'aikatun gwamnati wanda suke juya akalar ƙasar baki ɗaya. A cikin birnin Abuja akwai mutane a kalla 776,298 a kiɗayar da akayi a shekarar (2006), kasan cewar birnin na tarayya ne wato ya tara duk jinsin mutane da ƙabilun dake Najeriya gabaki ɗaya,  ko wacce jaha a Najeriya tana da wakilai a sassa daban-daban a cikin Abuja, domin ganin sun wakilci jihar su a fage da dama don cigaban jihar su. A cikin birnin Abuja akwai wuraren shaƙatawa da dama da wuraren buɗe ido musamman ga baƙi, waɗanda suke muradin kashe kwarkwatar ido ta fagen kallon abubuwan ban al'ajabi, da ɗebe kewa.

title: A cikin Hanyar Harmony
text:
"Into Harmony's Way" shi ne karo na bakwai na kakar wasa ta goma sha biyu kuma karo na 217 na Jerin wasan kwaikwayo na Family Guy . An watsa shi a kan Fox a Amurka a ranar 8 ga Disamba, 2013, kuma Julius Sharpe ne ya rubuta shi kuma Brian Iles ne ya ba da umarni.
Wannan labarin sananne ne saboda kasancewa na farko na jerin inda Brian Griffin ba ya nan (saboda mutuwarsa a cikin labarin da ya gabata, "Life of Brian"). Vinny ne ya maye gurbinsa a cikin labarin da kuma jerin buɗewa. Wannan labarin ya ci gaba da fitowar abubuwa uku da ke nuna mutuwar Brian, maye gurbinsa da tashin matattu.
Quagmire ya nemi ya zauna a gidan Griffin bayan ya yi hulɗa da wani mai canza tufafi a mashaya. Yayinda suke tare da Bitrus, ƙudan zuma ya sa su gano ta hanyar haɗari cewa za su iya raba sautin cikin jituwa. Bayan sun zauna don rubuta wasu waƙoƙi, sai suka je kantin magani na Mort don samun takarda kuma bayan Mort ya gaya wa aikinsa na baya a cikin kiɗa, sai ya zama manajan su kuma ya gayyace su su raira waƙa a ɗakin karatu yayin bude mic. Ya yi rikodin wasan kwaikwayon su kuma ya sanya bidiyon a kan JewTube (wani nau'in Yahudawa na YouTube), yana ba su gayyatar yin wasan kwaikwayo a bikin kiɗa. Ayyukansu sun yi nasara kuma sun sami tayin sabon manajan mai suna Ricky, sun kori Mort kuma suna tafiya a kan rashin amincewar Lois cewa tana buƙatar Peter ya kasance tare da iyalin a ranar godiya.

title: Abdulsalami Abubakar
text:
Abdulsalami Abubakar, shi tsohon janar ɗin Soja ne kuma ɗan Siyasa a Najeriya da yayi mulki na ɗan lokaci sannan ya miƙawa farar hula a tsakanin shekara ta alif ɗari tara da casa'in da takwas (1998 A.c) zuwa shekarar alif ɗari tara da casa'in da tara (1999). An haife shi a shekara ta alif ɗari tara da arba'in da biyu 1942 a birnin Minna, Jihar Neja dake arewacin Najeriya (a yau jihar Neja). Abdulsalami Abubakar yazama shugaban ƙasar Najeriya bayan rasuwar Janar Sani Abacha, yayi mulki daga watan Yunin shekara ta alif ɗari tara da chasa'in da takwas 1998 zuwa watan Mayun shekarar alif ɗari tara da chasa'in da tara 1999 (bayan Sani Abacha - kafin Olusegun Obasanjo).
A lokacin mulkinshi ne Najeriya ta fidda sabon kundin tsarin mulki wato 1979 constitution, wanda ta bada daman zaɓe tsakanin jam'iyyu daban daban. Abdulsalam ya miƙa madakon iko ga sabon zaɓaɓɓen shugaba Olusegun Obasanjo a ranar 29 ga watan Mayu shekara ta alif ɗari tara da chasa'in da tara 1999. Shine Chairman na yanzu na National Peace Committee.
== Kuruciya ==
An haifi Abdulsalam daga dangin Hausawa a ranar 13 ga watan Yuni shekara ta alif ɗari tara da arba'in da biyu 1942, mahaifinsa shine Abubakar Jibrin tare da mahaifiyarsa Fatikande Mohammed a Minna, Jihar Neja, Najeriya.

Tsohon malamin Jami'a kuma ɗan siyasa. Yayi mataimakin shugaban ƙasar Najeriya  daga shekara ta dubu biyu da bakwai, 2007, zuwa shekara ta dubu biyu da goma, 2010, (bayan Atiku Abubakar - kafin Namadi Sambo) a ƙarƙashin shugabancin Umaru Musa Yar'Adua. Ya kuma riƙe muƙamin Shugaban ƙasar ta Najeriya daga shekarar dubu biyu da goma, 2010, zuwa shekarar dubu biyu da goma sha biyar, 2015, inda Muhammadu Buhari ya kada shi a babban zaɓen ƙasar na 2015. Zaɓen da ya kasance karo na farko a tarihi da jamiyyan adawa ta kada jamiyya mai mulki.
== Haihuwa: ==
An haife Goodluck jonathan a ranar ashirin 20, ga watan Nuwanba shekara ta alif ɗari tara da hamsin da bakwai, 1957, a Ogbia dake jihar Bayelsa state. Shi ɗan kabilar ijaw ne. An haife shi a Otuoke, babanshi Lawrence Ebele Jonathan mai yin kwale-kwale ne, mamar sa kuma Eunice Ayi Ebele tsohowar manomiya ce. Yayi makarantar Christian primary and secondary school.
